My memory has no explicit ruling on "link versus something else," so I won't invent one.

What I do hold is the owner's earlier decisions. Under Option C (live components), previews are artifacts shown inside the dashboard: a `sheet` artifact through the `cawcoStage()` Vite plugin, served at `/@cawco/sheet`. For toolchains without a plugin API, the decision was an HTML `page` artifact. The owner also wanted "real code from the first screen."

So my best reading is an in-dashboard artifact rather than a bare URL. The open-at `?at=<docId>` link only deep-links to an item. If you meant a different preview context, tell me which and I'll go from there.
